method: Live @oai/sky, one physical input and refreshed screenshot per action. Significant native frames independently transcribed before implementing each workflow. Local pinned manual and Operation Guide read and visually inspected. Intermediate golden frames characterize implementation, not independent parity.
observations: STO and RCL retain current display and set ALPHA. STO A stores evaluated input and shows source→A. RCL during 2+ inserts A with recalled 7 below; ENT computes 9. Standalone RCL shows A= without changing ANS.
M+ after result 9 shows ANSM+ and operand 9, sets M. The accumulated total is not the lower result.
STO UP stores B+A without evaluating; upper B+A→, lower F1. RCL UP expands editable expression. Variables remain late bound.

ALGB prompts B then A for B+A, underlines active variable, shows ? and its current stored value. RIGHT and DOWN do not advance. ENT accepts numeric value and writes the variable. Repeat offers retained values. ON/C cancels and clears command while confirmed values remain.

MATH 0 prompts Start? default 0, then dx? default 0.00001. Start 1 for X²−2 returns X=1.414213562. ENT repeats with previous root as Start. Start -1 returns negative root. Repeated Start 0 after negative root returns negative root.
X²+1 from Start 1 and default dx shows Error 2 on upper line, lower blank; subsequent RCL X returns 0.
After storing 1 in F1, ON/C STO UP replaces it with literal 0 (upper 0→, lower F1); ON/C RCL UP recalls editable 0. Blank STO is not formula deletion. MEM clear/reset delete formula stores.

manualPolicy.formulaCapacity: 256 characters total across F1-F4; a function counts as one character. Replacement excludes old slot from total.
manualPolicy.persistence: ON/C and NORMAL HOME retain stores. OFF/ON retains stores. CA and mode changes clear temporary variables and ANS; M and formulas retained. Mode changes clear imaginary M. MEM clear/reset clear all stores. Closing the PC simulator clears its memories; this is not device power-cycle behavior.

limitations: Exact private Newton iteration limit and stopping criteria are not exposed by simulator. Implementation bounds work at 100 iterations and uses finite-difference Newton steps, residual and relative-step checks. Matching observed roots does not establish numerical algorithm parity across all functions.
Full STAT, EQN, CPLX, MAT and LIST numerical controllers remain later phases. Memory eligibility and typed ANS result boundary are tested independently for those modes.
Formula capacity follows full-manual specification and pure boundary tests; a live 256-character exhaustion was not measured.
Physical blinking cursor/variable underline timing and unobserved numeric prompt editing edge cases remain reportable parity gaps.
verification: Passed npm test: 345 unit tests, 134 browser tests, 226 golden frames. Native runtime and wrapper opened for this review were closed normally.
